people.name: Abijah
people.line: King of Judah, son of Rehoboam

people.name: Maacah
people.line: Daughter of Abishalom; wife of Rehoboam; mother of Abijah

people.name: Rehoboam
people.line: Son of Solomon, first king of Judah

translations.web: Rehoboam appointed Abijah the son of Maacah to be chief, the prince among his brothers; for he intended to make him king.
translations.bsb: Rehoboam appointed Abijah son of Maacah as chief prince among his brothers, intending to make him king.
translations.kjv: And Rehoboam made Abijah the son of Maachah the chief, to be ruler among his brethren: for he thought to make him king.
translations.asv: And Rehoboam appointed Abijah the son of Maacah to be chief, even the prince among his brethren; for he was minded to make him king.
